claude.sample_unit: blinded expert evaluations (20 cases x 6 models x 5 raters)

links.outcome: Expert-rated composite quality of LLM recommendations for complex interventional cardiology cases, with vs without guideline or web grounding
links.effect: ChatGPT with internet search 7.8 (7.5-8.0) and with ESC guidelines 7.7 (7.4-7.9) vs default ChatGPT 6.9 (6.6-7.3); differences across models P<.001.
links.quote: Performance significantly varied across LLMs (P less than .001), with ChatGPTi (7.8 [7.5-8.0]) and ChatGPT-gl (7.7 [7.4-7.9]) outperforming others.

models_evaluated: ChatGPT with European Society of Cardiology guidelines (ChatGPT-gl)
